note: McCook County SD zones its unincorporated land (2014 Revised Zoning Regulations adopt official zoning maps by reference), but the district maps are PDF documents and the county's only interactive zoning view is a Schneider Beacon viewer, not a queryable ArcGIS service. Salem's zoning map is a 2011 PDF with no GIS service. No ArcGIS Hub/Online zoning layer for McCook County, SD or its cities was found; Regrid parcel data carries zoning for only ~23% of parcels and is a commercial download, not a live service.
